events.title: Nimbus launches AI search
events.body: Nimbus Intranet released AI search across SharePoint and Google Drive. Available on the Enterprise plan only.

events.title: Corvid raises prices
events.body: Corvid Workspace moved its Business plan from 6 to 8 USD per user per month for new customers.

events.title: Helio adds frontline app
events.body: Helio Comms shipped a mobile app for frontline workers with shift schedules and offline reading.

events.title: Tandem partners with Slack
events.body: Tandem Hub announced a Slack integration that posts intranet news to Slack channels.

events.title: Quarry new CEO
events.body: Quarry Social appointed Dana Reyes as CEO. The founder becomes Chief Product Officer.

events.title: Nimbus ISO 27001
events.body: Nimbus Intranet obtained ISO 27001 certification for its EU data centers.

events.title: Corvid drops on-premise
events.body: Corvid Workspace will end its on-premise offer in June 2027. Customers must move to the cloud.

events.title: Helio targets retail
events.body: Helio Comms says retail is now its main market, with 40 new retail customers this year.

events.title: Tandem outage
events.body: Tandem Hub had a 6-hour outage in Europe. The company promised service credits.

events.title: Quarry free plan
events.body: Quarry Social launched a free plan for teams of up to 50 users.

events.title: Nimbus AI search for all
events.body: Nimbus Intranet made AI search available on all plans, not only Enterprise.

events.title: Corvid keeps on-premise
events.body: A Corvid Workspace sales rep told a prospect that on-premise remains available after 2027.

events.title: Helio acquires Pulsey
events.body: Helio Comms acquired Pulsey, a startup that runs employee surveys.

events.title: Tandem Teams app
events.body: Tandem Hub released a Microsoft Teams app with news, search and people directory.

events.title: Quarry layoffs
events.body: Quarry Social cut 15 percent of its staff, mostly in sales.

events.title: Nimbus wins bank deal
events.body: Nimbus Intranet signed a 30,000-seat deal with a European bank.

events.title: Corvid AI assistant
events.body: Corvid Workspace announced an AI assistant in beta, priced at 3 USD per user per month.

events.title: Helio price cut
events.body: Helio Comms lowered its frontline plan to 2 USD per user per month.

events.title: Tandem SOC 2
events.body: Tandem Hub completed its SOC 2 Type II audit.

events.title: Quarry free plan limit
events.body: Quarry Social lowered its free plan to teams of up to 25 users.
